examples.note: Dear Prescriber, I am the dispensing pharmacist for a shared patient (20-24, male). Amlodipine 5 mg was started 1 day after Diclofenac 100 mg, by a different prescriber. This is a possible prescribing cascade. Suspected reaction: possible raised BP. Evidence: listed in PSSA literature (source not yet verified); population signal aSR 1.7 (CI 1.2–2.5). Thank you for considering this. Could you please review whether Amlodipine 5 mg is treating a side-effect of Diclofenac 100 mg?
